Match the following statements in Column-I with their values in Column-II in the interval $\displaystyle \$left(-\frac{3\pi}{2}, \frac{3\pi}{2}\right)$:
Column-IColumn-II
(A) Abscissa of points where limit of (f {}^{{}^{\circ}} g)(x) exist is/are(P) -1
(B) Abscissa of points in domain of (g {}^{{}^{\circ}} f)(x), where limit of (g {}^{{}^{\circ}} f)(x) does not exist is/are(Q) \pi
(C) Abscissa of points of discontinuity of (f {}^{{}^{\circ}} g)(x) is/are(R) \displaystyle $\frac{5\pi}{6}$
(D) Abscissa of points of differentiability of (f {}^{{}^{\circ}} g)(x) is/are(S) -\pi
(T) 0
